domain: Autonomous Multirotor UAV for Medical Relief Air-Drop in Flood Operations
authorized_title: To what extent can an autonomous vision-guided multirotor UAV simulated in MuJoCo for payload-range trade-offs optimize last-mile medical relief drop accuracy during NDRF flood operations while establishing fleet utilization payback parity against ground transport?
